sections.title: Choose the word A, B, C or D whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.

questions.html: Question 1. A. teacher                 B. bread                 C. seat                         D. mean
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 1. A. teacher                 B. bread                 C. seat                         D. mean

Giải thích:

teacher /ˈtiːtʃər/: Phần "ea" được phát âm là /i:/.

bread /bred/: Phần "ea" được phát âm là /e/. KHÁC

seat /siːt/: Phần "ea" được phát âm là /i:/.

mean /miːn/: Phần "ea" được phát âm là /i:/.

questions.html: Question 2. A. books                   B. dogs                  C. cats                         D. maps
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 2. A. books                    B. dogs                 C. cats                         D. maps

Giải thích:

books /bʊks/: Âm cuối "k" là âm vô thanh, nên "s" phát âm là /s/.

dogs /dɒɡz/: Âm cuối "g" là âm hữu thanh, nên "s" phát âm là /z/. KHÁC

cats /kæts/: Âm cuối "t" là âm vô thanh, nên "s" phát âm là /s/.

maps /mæps/: Âm cuối "p" là âm vô thanh, nên "s" phát âm là /s/.

questions.html:
Question 3. Many young people are keen on _______ photos and sharing them on Instagram.

A. making                 B. taking                  C. doing                 D. creating
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 3. Many young people are keen on _______ photos and sharing them on Instagram.

A. making                 B. taking                 C. doing                 D. creating

Giải thích: Cụm từ cố định (collocation) để chỉ hành động "chụp ảnh" là "take photos"

questions.html:
Question 4. The comedy was so ______________ that we couldn't stop laughing.

A. boring                 B. hilarious                 C. scary                 D. sad
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 4. The comedy was so ______________ that we couldn't stop laughing.

A. boring                 B. hilarious                 C. scary                 D. sad

Giải thích: Vế sau "we couldn't stop laughing" (chúng tôi không thể nhịn cười) cho thấy bộ phim rất hài hước.

questions.html:
Question 5. We should all work together to build a strong and ______________ community.

A. connected                 B. united                 C. separated                         D. lonely
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 5. We should all work together to build a strong and ______________ community.

A. connected                 B. united                 C. separated                         D. lonely

Giải thích: Để xây dựng một cộng đồng "mạnh mẽ" (strong), chúng ta cần "đoàn kết" (united).

questions.html:
Question 6. In the harvest season, the ________ are full of golden rice.

A. rivers                 B. mountains                 C. fields                         D. lakes
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 6. In the harvest season, the ________ are full of golden rice.

A. rivers                 B. mountains                 C. fields                         D. lakes

Giải thích: "Golden rice" (lúa chín vàng) thường có ở "fields" (những cánh đồng) vào mùa thu hoạch

questions.html:
Question 7. Life in a big ________ can be exciting, but it's also very noisy.

A. village                 B. city                         C. countryside                 D. farm
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 7. Life in a big ________ can be exciting, but it's also very noisy.

A. village                 B. city                         C. countryside                 D. farm

Giải thích: Đặc điểm "exciting" (thú vị) nhưng "very noisy" (rất ồn ào) là đặc trưng của cuộc sống ở "city" (thành phố lớn)

questions.html:
Question 8. This new phone is _______ than my old one.

A. good                 B. better                 C. best                         D. more good
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 8. This new phone is _______ than my old one.

A. good                 B. better                 C. best                         D. more good

Giải thích: Đây là cấu trúc so sánh hơn. "Than" là dấu hiệu của so sánh hơn. Dạng so sánh hơn của tính từ "good" là "better".

questions.html:
Question 9. He enjoys _____________ to music in his free time.

A. listen                 B. listens                 C. listened                         D. listening
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 9. He enjoys _____________ to music in his free time.

A. listen                 B. listens                 C. listened                         D. listening

Giải thích: Động từ "enjoy" (thích thú) được theo sau bởi một động từ ở dạng V-ing (danh động từ).

questions.html:
Question 10. A: How about going to the cinema tonight? B: ____________________

A. I'm busy.                                                 B. That's a great idea!         

C. I don't like it.                                         D. Yes, I am.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 10. A: How about going to the cinema tonight? B: ____________________

A. I'm busy.                                                B. That's a great idea!         

C. I don't like it.                                         D. Yes, I am.

Giải thích: Câu "How about...?" là một lời gợi ý. Để đáp lại một cách tích cực, ta có thể dùng "That's a great idea!" (Đó là một ý kiến hay!).

questions.html:
Question 11. She speaks English _______ than I do.

A. more fluent         B. fluently                 C. more fluently                 D. fluentlier
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 11. She speaks English _______ than I do.

A. more fluent         B. fluently                 C. more fluently                 D. fluentlier

Giải thích: Đây là cấu trúc so sánh hơn với trạng từ. "Fluently" là một trạng từ dài, vì vậy dạng so sánh hơn của nó là "more fluently".

questions.html:
Question 12. A: Thank you so much for your help! B: ____________________

A. You're welcome.                                         B. Thank you too.

C. That's right.                                         D. I'm fine.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 12. A: Thank you so much for your help! B: ____________________

A. You're welcome.                                         B. Thank you too.

C. That's right.                                         D. I'm fine.

Giải thích: "You're welcome" (Không có gì đâu) là cách đáp lại lịch sự và phổ biến nhất khi ai đó cảm ơn bạn.

Question 15. Life in the countryside is more peaceful and quiet as in the city.

A. Life                 B. is                         C. quiet                 D. as
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 15. Life in the countryside is more peaceful and quiet as in the city.

questions.html:
Question 16. My brother don't like playing board games; he prefers video games.

A. don't                 B. playing                 C. games                 D. prefers
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 16. My brother don't like playing board games; he prefers video games.

A. don't                 B. playing                 C. games                 D. prefers

Giải thích: Chủ ngữ "My brother" là ngôi thứ ba số ít. Do đó, trợ động từ ở thể phủ định phải là "doesn't", không phải "don't".

Question 17. A. gallery                 B. museum                 C. collection                         D. expensive

gallery /ˈɡæləri/: Trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất.

relax /rɪˈlæks/: Trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai.

sections.introHtml: Bat Trang is one of the most famous (23)______ craft villages in Viet Nam. It is located near Ha Noi, on the left bank of the Red River, which makes it convenient for trading and transporting goods. The village is well-known for (24)______ beautiful ceramic products that have unique designs and high quality. For centuries, artisans in Bat Trang have passed down their skills from generation to (25) ______, keeping traditional values alive. They use clay to create various items like vases, bowls, and plates, and nowadays they even make decorative lamps and statues. Visiting the village, tourists can (26) ______how to make pottery themselves and learn each step from preparing the clay to painting the products. It is a very (27)______ experience that helps people understand more about Vietnamese culture and traditional handicrafts.

questions.html: Question 23. A. traditional                 B. modern                C. new                 D. old
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 23. A. traditional                 B. modern                 C. new                 D. old

Giải thích: Bát Tràng là một làng nghề có lịch sử lâu đời, vì vậy từ "traditional" (truyền thống) là phù hợp nhất.

questions.html: Question 24. A. their                          B. its                        C. it's                    D. they
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 24. A. their                         B. its                         C. it's                         D. they

Giải thích: Cần một tính từ sở hữu để chỉ "sản phẩm gốm sứ đẹp của nó" (của ngôi làng). "The village" là danh từ số ít, chỉ vật, nên dùng "its".

questions.html: Question 25. A. generation                 B. family                 C. people              D. artisan
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 25. A. generation                 B. family                 C. people                 D. artisan

Giải thích: Cụm từ cố định "from generation to generation" có nghĩa là "từ thế hệ này sang thế hệ khác"

questions.html: Question 26. A. learning                  B. to learn                C. learn                 D. learned
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 26. A. learning                 B. to learn                 C. learn                 D. learned

Giải thích: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu "can" là một động từ nguyên thể không "to".

questions.html: Question 27. A. interested                 B. interesting            C. interest             D. interests
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 27. A. interested                 B. interesting                 C. interest                 D. interests

Giải thích: Cần một tính từ để miêu tả bản chất của "experience" (trải nghiệm). Dùng tính từ đuôi "-ing" ("interesting": thú vị) để mô tả bản chất của sự vật, sự việc. (Tính từ đuôi "-ed" dùng để diễn tả cảm xúc của con người).

sections.title: Read the following passage and choose the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions.
sections.introHtml:
Reading is a wonderful hobby for people of all ages. It is more than just a way to pass the time; it is a way to explore new worlds and ideas without leaving your chair. When you read, you can travel to distant lands, meet fascinating characters, and learn about different cultures and historical events.

One of the greatest benefits of reading is its effect on the brain. It improves your vocabulary and communication skills. It also enhances your concentration and focus. Studies have shown that reading regularly can help reduce stress. Getting lost in a good book can be a great way to relax and forget about daily worries.

To make reading a habit, you should choose books on topics that you find interesting. It doesn't matter if you prefer fiction, non-fiction, comics, or magazines. The most important thing is to read regularly. Setting aside even 15-20 minutes a day for reading can make a big difference.

questions.html:
Question 28. What is the main idea of the passage?

A. Reading is a difficult hobby.

B. The benefits of reading regularly.

C. How to write a book.

D. Different types of books.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 28. What is the main idea of the passage?

A. Reading is a difficult hobby.

B. The benefits of reading regularly. 

C. How to write a book.

D. Different types of books.

Giải thích: Đoạn văn nói về việc đọc sách là một sở thích tuyệt vời, giúp khám phá thế giới, cải thiện trí não, giảm căng thẳng. Toàn bộ nội dung đều nhấn mạnh vào lợi ích của việc đọc.

questions.html:
Question 29. According to the passage, reading can help reduce stress because...

A. it is a physical activity.

B. it makes you feel tired.

C. it allows you to escape from daily worries.

D. it is a competitive hobby.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 29. According to the passage, reading can help reduce stress because...

A. it is a physical activity.

B. it makes you feel tired.

C. it allows you to escape from daily worries. 

D. it is a competitive hobby.

Giải thích: Câu trong bài: "Getting lost in a good book can be a great way to relax and forget about daily worries." (Đắm mình trong một cuốn sách hay có thể là một cách tuyệt vời để thư giãn và quên đi những lo lắng hàng ngày.)

questions.html:
Question 30. The word "enhances" in the passage is closest in meaning to...

A. reduces                 B. improves                         C. weakens                         D. stops.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 30. The word "enhances" in the passage is closest in meaning to...

A. reduces                 B. improves                         C. weakens                         D. stops.

Giải thích: Câu trong bài: "Getting lost in a good book can be a great way to relax and forget about daily worries." (Đắm mình trong một cuốn sách hay có thể là một cách tuyệt vời để thư giãn và quên đi những lo lắng hàng ngày.)

questions.html:
Question 31. How much time does the passage suggest for daily reading?

A. One hour               B. Two hours                       C. 15-20 minutes                 D. 5 minutes.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 31. How much time does the passage suggest for daily reading?

A. One hour                 B. Two hours                         C. 15-20 minutes                 D. 5 minutes.

Giải thích: Câu trong bài: "Setting aside even 15-20 minutes a day for reading can make a big difference." (Dành ra dù chỉ 15-20 phút mỗi ngày để đọc sách cũng có thể tạo ra sự khác biệt lớn.)

questions.html:
Question 32. Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of reading?

A. Improving vocabulary

B. Reducing stress

C. Earning more money

D. Enhancing concentration.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 32. Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of reading?

A. Improving vocabulary

B. Reducing stress

C. Earning more money 

D. Enhancing concentration.

Giải thích: Đoạn văn có đề cập đến "improves your vocabulary" (cải thiện vốn từ vựng), "reduce stress" (giảm căng thẳng), và "enhances your concentration" (tăng cường sự tập trung). Việc "Earning more money" (Kiếm nhiều tiền hơn) không được nhắc đến

sections.title: Choose the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the sentence that is best made from the given cues in each of following questions.

questions.html:
Question 33. My brother / prefer / play / football / watch / it / TV.

A. My brother prefers playing football to watching it on TV.

B. My brother prefer to play football than watching it on TV.

C. My brother prefers playing football than watch it on TV.

D. My brother prefer play football to watch it on TV.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 33. My brother / prefer / play / football / watch / it / TV.

A. My brother prefers playing football to watching it on TV. 

B. My brother prefer to play football than watching it on TV.

C. My brother prefers playing football than watch it on TV.

D. My brother prefer play football to watch it on TV.

Giải thích: Cấu trúc "prefer + V-ing + to + V-ing" (thích làm gì hơn làm gì). Chủ ngữ "My brother" là ngôi thứ ba số ít nên động từ "prefer" phải thêm "s".

questions.html:
Question 34. Life / countryside / peaceful / life / city.

A. Life in countryside is more peaceful than life in the city.

B. Life in the countryside is peaceful than life in the city.

C. Life in the countryside is more peaceful than life in the city.

D. Life in countryside is peaceful than life in city.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 34. Life / countryside / peaceful / life / city.

A. Life in countryside is more peaceful than life in the city.

B. Life in the countryside is peaceful than life in the city.

C. Life in the countryside is more peaceful than life in the city. 

D. Life in countryside is peaceful than life in city.

Giải thích: Đây là câu so sánh hơn với tính từ dài "peaceful", cấu trúc là "more peaceful than". Cần có mạo từ "the" trước "countryside" và "city".

questions.html:
Question 35. You / should / finish / homework / before / go / bed.

A. You should to finish your homework before go to bed.

B. You should finish your homework before going to bed.

C. You should finishing your homework before go to bed.

D. You should finish your homework before to go to bed.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 35. You / should / finish / homework / before / go / bed.

A. You should to finish your homework before go to bed.

B. You should finish your homework before going to bed. 

C. You should finishing your homework before go to bed.

D. You should finish your homework before to go to bed.

Giải thích: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu "should" là động từ nguyên thể ("finish"). Sau giới từ "before" là động từ dạng V-ing ("going"). Cụm từ "đi ngủ" là "go to bed".

questions.html:
Question 36. She / interested / learn / traditional / musical instruments.

A. She interested in learning traditional musical instruments.

B. She is interested to learn traditional musical instruments.

C. She is interest in learning traditional musical instruments.

D. She is interested in learning traditional musical instruments.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 36. She / interested / learn / traditional / musical instruments.

A. She interested in learning traditional musical instruments.

B. She is interested to learn traditional musical instruments.

C. She is interest in learning traditional musical instruments.

D. She is interested in learning traditional musical instruments.

Giải thích: Cấu trúc "to be interested in + V-ing" (thích thú, quan tâm đến việc làm gì). Chủ ngữ "She" đi với "is"

sections.title: Choose the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original sentence in each of following questions.

questions.html:
Question 37. He likes playing video games. His mother doesn't like it.

A. He likes playing video games, but his mother doesn't like it.

B. He likes playing video games, but his mother don't like it.

C. He likes play video games, but his mother doesn't like it.

D. He likes playing video games but his mother not likes it.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 37. He likes playing video games. His mother doesn't like it.

A. He likes playing video games, but his mother doesn't like it. 

B. He likes playing video games, but his mother don't like it.

C. He likes play video games, but his mother doesn't like it.

D. He likes playing video games but his mother not likes it.

Giải thích: Dùng liên từ "but" (nhưng) để nối hai câu có ý nghĩa tương phản. Động từ và trợ động từ ở hai vế đã được chia đúng.

questions.html:
Question 38. My new house is bigger than my old house.

A. My old house is smaller as my new house.

B. My old house is more small than my new house.

C. My old house is smaller than my new house.

D. My old house is smallest than my new house.
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 38. My new house is bigger than my old house.

A. My old house is smaller as my new house.

B. My old house is more small than my new house.

C. My old house is smaller than my new house. 

D. My old house is smallest than my new house.

Giải thích: Câu này có thể viết lại theo nghĩa ngược lại: "Nhà cũ của tôi nhỏ hơn nhà mới của tôi." Dạng so sánh hơn của "small" là "smaller".

questions.html:
Question 39. Let's go for a walk in the park.

A. How about go for a walk in the park?

B. How about going for a walk in the park?

C. How about to go for a walk in the park?

D. How about we going for a walk in the park?
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 39. Let's go for a walk in the park.

A. How about go for a walk in the park?

B. How about going for a walk in the park? 

C. How about to go for a walk in the park?

D. How about we going for a walk in the park?

Giải thích: Cấu trúc gợi ý "Let's + V (nguyên thể)..." tương đương với cấu trúc "How about + V-ing...?

A. I am keen on listen to pop music.

D. I am keen on listening to pop music
questions.referenceHtml:
Question 40. I really enjoy listening to pop music.

A. I am keen on listen to pop music.

B. I am keen to listening to pop music.

C. I am keen of listening to pop music.

D. I am keen on listening to pop music.

Giải thích: Cấu trúc "enjoy + V-ing" (thích làm gì) đồng nghĩa với cấu trúc "be keen on + V-ing" (say mê, thích làm gì).
